results.name: S1  HTTPS redirect script is the first script in <head>
S2  CSP meta present with object-src none, base-uri self, upgrade-insecure-requests
S3  CSP connect-src is limited to own origin + the Supabase project
S4  every err message rendered into HTML goes through esc()
S5  hard-coded demo OTP removed
S6  no Math.random left for OTP / ids
S7  password hash is PBKDF2 (no unsalted SHA-256, no base64 fallback)
S8  legacy local login no longer auto-creates accounts
S9  vault key is never written to localStorage (no 'k:' / 's:' session payload)
S10 no direct-table upsert fallback and no local_ account creation in auth code
S11 service worker never caches cross-origin / authenticated requests
S12 Edge Functions: JWT verified, rate limited, CORS allow-list (no wildcard)
S13 Edge Functions pin supabase-js to an exact version
S14 SQL: RLS on, rate-limit fn is SECURITY DEFINER with empty search_path, no anon/PUBLIC grants
S15 SQL: parameterised only (no EXECUTE / dynamic SQL anywhere in migrations)
S16 no raw SQL string building in frontend or functions
S17 auth config: min password 12, confirmations on, signups rate limited, anon off
S18 no admin routes / pages / debug flags exist
S19 no secret/service-role keys or JWTs in shipped files (only the public publishable key)
E1  allowed origin gets CORS header, no wildcard
E2  foreign origin is rejected with 403
E3  non-POST rejected with 405
E4  preflight returns 204
E5  no ALLOWED_ORIGINS configured => browser requests fail closed (503)
E6  rate limit: RPC false => limited
E7  rate limit: RPC error => fails closed
T1  sign-up with a short password is rejected client-side (no API call)
T1b password without digits rejected
T1c password containing the e-mail name rejected
T2  sign-up without confirmed e-mail opens no vault and writes no local vault/session
T3a legacy session containing the vault key is deleted on load
T3b login succeeds and opens the home screen
T3c derived vault key is NOT present anywhere in localStorage
T3d only ciphertext+salt were sent to the Edge Function, never the key or plaintext
T3e sign-out clears cached ciphertext and session
T4a (setup) a cached local vault exists on the device
T4b with the server refusing the login, the cached local vault does NOT let anyone in
T4c network failure during login is handled (no crash, no entry)
T5  when secure-vault fails there is no direct idc_vaults upsert fallback
T6  tampered vault rejected: path traversal in attachment
T6  tampered vault rejected: script-injection id
T7  after 5 bad logins the client stops calling the API (back-off active)
T8  page reload with a stored Supabase session shows the lock screen (key not recoverable)
T8b sign-out in another tab wipes in-memory state
